name: Cross-account scoped sts:AssumeRole fully removed by an explicit Deny (negative; deny)
note: S2-crossaccount-scoped-surface (A) Deny interaction: the Allow would be a cross-account scoped assume (role in 999999999999, subject 123456789012), but a same-policy unconditional Deny on sts:AssumeRole removes the path (AWS explicit-Deny precedence). CROSS-ACCOUNT-ASSUME-ROLE must NOT fire - a denied capability is not a grant. Witnesses the negative and Deny cells.
